purpose: A95 central same-physical-wall displaced Accepted reference and bounded serial flat qualification; not terrain or full-domain preservation

fit.normalization: original measured40mm interpolation; fixed u_tau and nu=1/10500; no fitted-U40 renormalization
fit.sensitivity: 64 joint coordinate/velocity corners plus centre for the three selected points; fixed membership, normalization, u_tau,d,nu; deterministic evaluated envelope, not confidence interval; failed roots retained

physics.coefficients: original Natural defining q/kappa, total epsilon, DeviatoricStrainV1
physics.wall: finite-nu original resistance and roughness correlation; fixed fitted h_s; evolving interface K enters all actual profiles
physics.sink: A(K)/(max(r,c)-d), d<c<=H; monotone flat or positive-J budget; zero prescribed local reaction; transported nonconstant inner k; no inner epsilon equation
physics.outer: zero molecular diffusion; full-height U=utau/kappa log((z-d)/z0),constant K,epsilon=A/(z-d)
physics.prohibited: clipping, floors, stress projection, post-k repair, reference cancellation/restoration, EP, extra governing sweeps

boundary.top: w essential; tx=utau2,gk=0,geps=-utau4/(sigmaE*(Z-d)),physical prescribed diffusion independent of evolving nut; inlet owns corners
boundary.pressure: absolute full nonlinear outlet traction; no extra top normal traction or pressure gauge

native_preflight.scope: serial affine flat2D A95 Natural, isotropic Modified_A P4/P2, cacheOff,3000slot guard
native_preflight.radial_recipe: physical breakpoints plus H/64,H/32,H/16,H/8,H/4,H/2,H and fixed geometric1.5 outer grading to20; one deterministic preflight may reduce streamwise columns or choose P3/P1 to meet cap; freeze exact grid and count before trajectories

evolution.initialization: fresh zero-step native histories; identical actual coefficients within a space; continuous reference fixed
evolution.stop: zero-step domain and independent operator admission first; stop affected pair at first genuine hard physical/required milestone accuracy failure; retain attempt and last history; do not add meshes or smaller dt to seek survivor
evolution.norm: weighted physical RMS on common partition-split Gauss grid, fixed scales utau,K0,epsilon(H),utau2; absolute pressure; drift from actual initial reported separately from reference error

verification.oracle: independent finite-nu split quadrature, root and Q stationary extrema; no production kernel expected answers
negative_controls: wrong top shear or epsilon flux

independent_work.CT6: sealed states read-only mass-norm vectors,alignment,a-2b,absolute errors and pressure; old gates unchanged; no new curved evolution
independent_work.domain: matched[-25,30]Hh roof20,HA=.1875,explicit new radial grid/native counts/geometry; no over-limit evolution
independent_work.CT9: inspect every reachable dense startup,mass,assembly,pressure/admissibility/diagnostic path and verified sparse dependencies; design only
